gloss: rice with tamagoyaki; egg and rice dish

definitions.gloss: rice served with tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelet)
definitions.explanation: A simple home-style dish consisting of steamed rice topped with or accompanied by tamagoyaki. Popular as a quick breakfast or lunch option.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{卵焼|たまごや}きご{飯|はん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have tamagoyaki rice for breakfast.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧な{卵焼|たまごや}きご{飯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made tamagoyaki rice, which my child loves.

examples.japanese: ⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧な{卵焼|たまごや}きご{飯|はん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Simple tamagoyaki rice is the most delicious.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧ (tamagoyaki, Japanese omelet) + ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ (rice, meal)

SIMILAR DISHES:
- ⟦{卵|たまご}かけご{飯|はん}→卵かけご飯：07562_tamagokakegohan⟧ (TKG) - raw egg over hot rice
- ⟦{目玉焼|めだまや}き→目玉焼き：14946_medamayaki⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ - rice with fried egg
- オムライス - omurice (omelet rice)
- ⟦{親子丼|おやこどん}→親子丼：17621_oyakodon⟧ - chicken and egg rice bowl

FORMS:
{卵焼|たまごや}きご{飯|はん} can be served with the tamagoyaki on top of the rice or on the side. Some add soy sauce, mayonnaise, or ketchup.
